goal: Die Persistenzgrenze für Masken ausschließlich als Preview-, Integritäts- und Recovery-Vertrag planen. Kein produktiver Write wird geöffnet.

guide_delta.summary: I129 definiert den späteren Save-Pfad als gebundene Kette aus Kandidat, Preview-Fingerprint, Integritätsprüfung, Recovery-Punkt, atomarem Commit und Read-back-Verifikation. Noch wird nichts gespeichert.

direct_dependencies: MaskTemplateStore already provides validated atomic file replacement and optimistic version checks
browser shell has no persistence/network write path
tests_required: Step 1: documentation structure and boundary consistency check
Step 1: preview and commit must bind the same deterministic fingerprint
Step 1: recovery point must precede update commit
Step 1: browser must remain separated from MaskTemplateStore
Step 2 after green: close only the TODO item for planning the persistence boundary
Step 2: synchronize README/TODO progress without claiming a working Save feature
tests_explicitly_not_run: browser tests because no browser runtime changes
store tests because MaskTemplateStore implementation is unchanged
database tests because SQLite is outside this contract
Control Plane behavior tests because governance implementation is unchanged
risks: a plan that lets preview and commit derive from different draft states would permit TOCTOU drift
recovery after overwrite is impossible unless the previous valid state is captured first
documentation must not imply persistence is already enabled
expected_side_effects: future persistence work has explicit Preview -> Integrity -> Recovery -> Commit -> Read-back gates before implementation
the persistence-boundary planning TODO is closed without enabling any Save path
